name: Intelligent Destruction
summary:
Intelligent Destruction was coded in 48 hours by Zach Barth for the RPI GameJam competition which ended on April 11, 2008 and is a two player hot-seat game played locally on one computer.

It is based on a board game that he was working on called Infinitron.

Research units and then* build them* to capture cities to gain points (gained at the beginning of your turn) and increase your unit cap. Researching and building units costs points. When you capture a city, you can create and shape the terrain around the city, but only once. Begin your turn with one of your units on the enemy capital to win the game.
